clauses.text: Parliament shall by law provide for the Commissioner establishment of the office of the Parliamentary for Administration Commissioner for Administration (Ombudsman) charged with the duty of investigating and reporting upon com- plaints or allegations of the infringement of fundamental rights and other injustices by public officers and officers of public corporations, local authorities and other like institu- tions, in accordance with and subject to the provisions of such law.
The Parliamentary Commissioner for shall, Subject to the approval of the Constitutional Council, be appointed by the President and shall hold office during good behaviour.
The salary of the Parliamentary Commissioner for Administration shall be determined by Parliament and shall not be diminished during his term of office.

The office of the Parliamentary Commissioner for Administration shall become vacant – (a) upon his death; (b) on his resignation in writing addressed to the President; (c) on his attaining the age fixed by law; (d) on his removal by the President on account of ill health or physical or mental infirmity; or (e) on his removal by the President on an address of Parliament.

Whenever the Parliamentary Commissioner for Administration is unable to perform and discharge the duties and functions of his office, the President shall, Subject to the approval of the Constitutional Council, appoint a person to act in his place.
